description:
Prof. Yogesh Wankhede
Consulting Psychologist | Founder, Mind Search Counseling & Training Centre

With a strong commitment to mental well-being and personal development, my work focuses on helping individuals gain clarity, confidence, and direction in both personal and academic journeys. Through Mind Search Counseling & Training Centre, I provide structured, practical counselling tailored to individual needs.

I offer guidance for students navigating important academic decisions, including career planning and preparation strategies for competitive exams such as JEE, NEET, and CET, supported by psychometric assessments. My counselling also extends to marital and pre-marital support, along with assistance for behavioral concerns and social adjustment.

In addition to individual counselling, I conduct training programs and workshops in soft skills, behavioral development, relationship dynamics, and effective parenting, aimed at fostering balanced personal and professional growth.
